C9000130.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 130 (Exact Fourier transforms below $`n\log n`$.; papers: An explicit power saving for the exact discrete Fourier transform; Finite tensor savings and exact Fourier circuits; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/130.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

N_SCALAR.statement: net:scalar: for arbitrary complex bank and auxiliary inputs, the eight-row invocation is (x,y,A,c) -> (x,y+x,A,c); the inverse middle stage gives the signed exchange (X,Y) -> (-Y,X) and restores every auxiliary.

N_BINARY.statement: Every finite-dimensional nondegenerate symmetric binary bilinear space containing a norm-one vector admits an orthonormal basis; the unit-plus-hyperbolic-plane change is invertible and orthonormal.

N_EDGE.statement: net:edge: for nested nondegenerate subspaces of the ordinary binary dot space, an orthonormal residual basis of size rho factors Phi_V Phi_U^{-1} into rho forward or inverse kernels C_z; C_z^{-1}=R_z C_z.

N_LABELS.statement: The actual chronological gate incidences and net:labels, including reversed stage 2, have nested nondegenerate endpoint labels; their nonzero residuals have norm-one vectors and orthonormal bases, with matching interstage boundaries.

N_RESIDUALS.statement: net:residuals for h=100: the physical-edge absolute dimension sum is s=1873807244636671267308000000, W=1873807244643542670000, m=1000000, and Wm-s=6871402692000000; auxiliary source/sink edges are included.

N_TERMINAL.statement: The exceptional routed X_d-to-Y_d frame ratio is R_{u_d} C^{tensor m}, wt(u_d)=27, whereas every other routed role has ratio C^{tensor m}; translations and the signed exchange correct all roles.

N_LIFT.statement: Common-frame cancellation, directional conjugacy to selected-bit fibers, and terminal corrections hold for every integer f>=1 and arbitrary spectator bits; only address frames are tensor-powered, not the bank-role exchange.

N_INTERFACE.statement: net:finite-interface: for every integer f>=1 and every number of spectator bits, the h=100 network transforms each of W arbitrary arrays by C^{tensor mf} using exactly s grouped directional steps and only a fixed number of other pointwise maps and address permutations.

N_INDEX.statement: net:indexing: for fixed m and a fixed invertible binary column map, all-column address changes, fixed column translations and selected-bit fiber packing on k=mf+r bits cost O(2^k), including O(f+1) setup and data movement.

N_TENSOR.statement: net:tensor-bound: W_star=2^71, S=(2^71)*1000000-6871402692000000 and lambda=S/W_star give t(k)<=A+lambda*t(floor(k/1000000)); exact batches imply C^{tensor k} costs O(2^k(k+1)^theta), theta=log_1000000(lambda)<1, for all k>=0.

N_GENERAL.statement: For every integer h>=7 the same triple network has the all-role all-f interface with m=h^3, v=binomial(h,3), I=3v^2, W=2v^3+I(v*(binomial(h-3,3)+3(h-3))+h+1) and s=Wm-2v^2(v-3h(h+1)); its strict saving holds exactly for integer h>=22.

N_IMPROVED.statement: For h=25, the same all-role construction has m=15625, W=58645352620000, Delta=3703000000, W_star=2^46 and lambda=17179869126140625/1099511627776. Its charged tensor bound holds for every k>=0, and 1-log_15625(lambda) is greater than 1500 times the corresponding gap for the padded h=100 construction.

E_LOCAL.statement: Unaudited loc:compiler: F_r(u) has an exact-width synchronized monomial/C-slot word of O(1+log^4 r) layers, with polynomial preparation and roots of order at most 8r.

E_SECTORS.statement: Unaudited lem:sector-address: mixed-radix sector start is the stated prefix-product sum, and sector packing, unpacking and enumeration cost O(R).

E_SYNC.statement: Unaudited prop:tensor-fourier: the tensor product of Fourier factors of total length R costs O(R*(ell+1)^theta*(1+log r_max)^4) plus polynomial preparation.

E_PRIMES.statement: Unaudited lem:prime-lengths: odd primes r_j=O((j+1)^2) give log(product r_j)=Theta(ell log ell) and ell=Theta(log n/log log n) for the maximal product below 2n, with polylogarithmic construction.

E_LENGTH.statement: Unaudited working-length claim: the least L=R_ell*2^e>=2n satisfies 2n<=L<4n, 2^e<2r_{ell+1}, and e=O(log ell).

E_CHIRP.statement: Unaudited chirp convolution and CRT transfer: the length-n Fourier transform reduces to three length-L transforms and O(L) charged preparation for L>=2n.

E_ROOT.statement: Unaudited master-root claim: D*=(2n)L*2^ceil(log_2(16L))<1024n^3 supplies all chirp, factor and local roots as powers of one input root.

E_MAIN.statement: Unaudited primary main theorem: for every n the exact deterministic DFT has cost O(n*(log n)^theta*(log log n)^(4-theta)), using one supplied root of order D*<1024n^3.

Q_PRICE.statement: Unaudited thm:prices: a no-finite-win hypothesis yields normalized global matrix prices, zero on monomials, product-subadditive, tensor/direct-sum additive, and invariant under inverse, transpose and monomial changes.

Q_WORD.statement: Unaudited price:word-bounds: under the price axioms, identity padding is free, nontrivial elementary shears cost one and invertible 2-by-2 matrices cost at most two.

Q_BOUNDARY.statement: Unaudited lem:boundary-comparison: polynomial tensor evaluation modulo an admissible monic polynomial differs from its coefficient Toeplitz price by at most C_G*N*(t log(2t)+(k+1)^6), uniformly in the modulus.

Q_FEEDBACK.statement: Unaudited thm:feedback: for invertible K=[[M,C],[B,D]] with M invertible, a regular invertible H(s)=M+sC(I-sD)^(-1)B satisfies p(H(s))<=p(K), without assuming D invertible.

Q_SPECIAL.statement: Unaudited thm:specialization: a rational matrix regular and invertible at z0 inherits a generic price upper bound holding off a finite exceptional set.

Q_PIVOT.statement: Unaudited lem:pivot-bound: for invertible K=[[A,C],[B,D]] with A,D invertible, pivoting to [[A-CD^(-1)B,CD^(-1)],[-D^(-1)B,D^(-1)]] increases price by at most 4r.

Q_SCALAR_PIVOT.statement: Unaudited lem:scalar-pivot: a one-coordinate pivot preserves price exactly, using the one-coordinate intersection argument.

Q_DENSE.statement: Unaudited lem:pair-price: every invertible dense 2-by-2 complex matrix has price at most 3/2.

Q_REFLECT.statement: Unaudited sparse-reflection bound: reflection in the kernel of a real symmetric matrix with h supported off-diagonal pairs has price at most 3h/2+2w.

Q_WIN.statement: Unaudited thm:finite-win: the reflection construction contradicts the no-win price bounds and yields a nonmonomial q-by-q matrix A whose tensor power A^{tensor b} uses fewer than b*q^(b-1) A-calls with free monomial maps.

Q_TRANSFER.statement: Unaudited prop:win-to-fourier: a finite tensor saving transfers to exact Fourier circuits with an asymptotic saving along an unbounded sequence of lengths.

Q_FOURIER.statement: Unaudited companion main claim: there are exact nonuniform complex Fourier circuits of size o(n log n) along an unbounded sequence, counting all additions, subtractions and scalar multiplications.
